newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Technodomiki's orderbook at 35.5bln drach.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Technodomiki's orderbook at 35.5bln drach.

text.p: Greek construction firm Hellenic Technodomiki's order book of uncompleted projects stands at 35.5 billion drachmas, it said in a statement.

The firm won contracts to build 70 houses for refugees in Orestiada budgeted at 0.9 billion drachmas, a new natural gas unit in Lavrio at 2.2 billion drachmas and the supermarche Liosion (Marinopoulos) budgeted at 1.7 billion drachmas.

It also participates in the consortium that won the tender to construct the national railways association (OSE) Eftaxia Peramos tunnel. Its share in the consortium is budgeted at 2.0 billion drachmas.
And Hellenic Technodomiki built the new Regency casino complex in Thessaloniki in a record 10-month period, it said.

The new Regency casino, owned by U.S Hyatt, will be inauguarted tonight in Thessaloniki. The one storey, 11,000 square meter building constructed on a 72,000 square meter site near the Makedonia International Airport, is the biggest of its type in Europe. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
